Marissa / Alice — looping in my notes from legal:

- NDA: fine to get the mutual NDA executed first. We typically do a quick check and sign within 1-3 business days.
- MSA: we request a clean MSA draft from Redwood to start redlines. Please send the MSA with core SOW/CLAUSES called out (liability cap, indemnity, data protections).
- DPA: Acme privacy team needs to review; if possible, include a DPA exhibit to the MSA. If you prefer embedding DPA clauses in the MSA, please highlight them. Expect ~7-10 business days for full privacy review.
- Security artifacts: SOC 2 Type II report and current subprocessor list are required for our security review. Please provide those after NDA is executed.

On redlines sequencing: we prefer one round of consolidated redlines from Acme Legal + Procurement to avoid iterative churn. If Redwood has specific non-negotiables, call them out upfront.
